name: dbt v2 additions to dbt OSS
sku: The proprietary layer of the standard dbt (v2) install, formerly the dbt Fusion engine, free to use under the dbt Product Licensing Agreement. It sits on the open-source layer, so it is scored only for what it adds. Strict static analysis and column-level lineage need `dbt login`, a free dbt platform account. dbt State (state-aware orchestration) is usage-based paid and Mesh and Catalog are seat-based paid, none of them scored here. Adapters are the same as dbt OSS: PostgreSQL is not listed.

transform.sql-transform.note: Adds a local compiler for SQL for the first time: after Jinja renders, the engine builds and checks a logical plan for every query without running it, so dialect and type mistakes are caught before they reach the warehouse.

bands.note: Column-level lineage, produced by building or compiling with strict static analysis, which needs a free login. Baseline analysis works without one. Covers dbt-managed nodes.

A language server gives autocomplete, hover information and inline errors, `dbt lint` gives SQLFluff-compatible linting with auto-fix, and the dbt VS Code extension is free to install. Some advanced features need a free login after a 14-day trial.

presentation.tagline: Local SQL compiler, language server and column-level lineage on top of dbt OSS.
